English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

bambu (uncountable)

  1. Obsolete form of bamboo.

Albanian

[edit]
Albanian Wikipedia has an article on:
bambuja
Wikipedia sq

Etymology

[edit]

From English bamboo, from Dutch bamboe, from Portuguese bambu, from Malay bambu, from Kannada ಬಮ್ಬು (bambu).

Noun

[edit]

bambu f (definite bambuja, definite plural bambutë)

  1. bamboo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “bambu”, in FGJSH: Fjalor i gjuhës shqipe [Dictionary of the Albanian language] (in Albanian), 2006

Finnish

[edit]
Finnish Wikipedia has an article on:
bambu
Wikipedia fi

Etymology

[edit]

From English bamboo, from Dutch bamboe, from Portuguese bambu, from Malay bambu, from Kannada ಬಂಬು (bambu).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbɑmbu/, [ˈbɑ̝mbu]
  • Rhymes: -ɑmbu
  • Syllabification(key): bam‧bu
  • Hyphenation(key): bam‧bu

Noun

[edit]

bambu

  1. bamboo
    Isopandat käyttävät bambuja pääravintonaan. ― Giant pandas use bamboo as their main source of nutrition.

Indonesian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Malay bambu, from Tamil வேம்பு (vēmpu). Cognate of Kannada ಬಂಬು (bambu).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Indonesian) IPA(key): /ˈbambu/ [ˈbam.bu]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ambu
  • Syllabification: bam‧bu

Noun

[edit]

bambu (countable and uncountable, plural bambu-bambu)

  1. bamboo (plant)
  2. bamboo (wood)

Synonyms

[edit]
  • aur
  • buluh
  • betung

Malay

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Proto-Dravidian *wē
Proto-Dravidian *mpu
Proto-Dravidian *wēmpu
Tamil வேம்பு (vēmpu)bor.
▲
Proto-Dravidian *wēmpu
Kannada ಬಂಬು (bambu)bor.
Malay bambu

    Borrowed from Tamil வேம்பு (vēmpu) and/or Kannada ಬಂಬು (bambu).

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /bambu/
    • Rhymes: -ambu, -bu, -u

    Noun

    [edit]

    bambu (Jawi spelling بمبو, plural bambu-bambu)

    1. bamboo (plant); bamboo (wood)
      Synonyms: aur, buluh

    Descendants

    [edit]
    • Indonesian: bambu
    • → Portuguese: bambu
      • → Asturian: bambú
      • → Catalan: bambú
      • → Dutch: bamboe (see there for further descendants)
      • → French: bambou
        • → Moore: bambu
        • → Norman: bambou
        • → Russian: бамбу́к (bambúk) (or Dutch bamboe or English bamboo) (see there for further descendants)
      • → Italian: bambù
      • → Spanish: bambú
    • → Tok Pisin: mambu

      Turkish

      [edit]
      Turkish Wikipedia has an article on:
      bambu
      Wikipedia tr

      Etymology

      [edit]

      Inherited from Ottoman Turkish بامبو (bambu), from French bambou, from Portuguese bambu, from Malay bambu, from Kannada ಬಂಬು (bambu), from Proto-Dravidian *wēmpu.

      Noun

      [edit]

      bambu (definite accusative bambuyu, plural bambular)

      1. bamboo, any fast-growing grass in the subfamily Bambusoideae and its wood
        Synonyms: hezaren, Hint kamışı
